### Bible Pathways - May 24, 2009
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-may-24-2009-11603910.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 10
Points:
- Rehoboam assumed power without prayer or preparing his heart to seek the Lord.
- When the people asked for lighter service, he rejected seasoned counsel in favor of arrogant peers.
- Threatening harsher burdens provoked the northern tribes to rebel and fracture the nation.
- Rehoboam's downfall demonstrates that pride blinds leaders and precedes destruction.
- Believers must exercise caution when seeking advice, ensuring all counsel aligns with God's Word.
